Welcome

At Panelcz in Chmelnice

The Panelcz holiday complex is in Chmelnice on the Vranov reservoir, about 100 metres from the sandy beach. It offers five separate, modern apartments, each with its own bathroom. Apartment no. 5 includes a large common room with a fireplace and bar for about 30 guests, where you can party even when it's freezing outside. All indoor spaces are heated by infrared panels, so it's cosy here in autumn and winter too.

Outside the summer season you can rent the whole complex just for yourselves. Warm up in the hot tub on the terrace or the sauna in the cellar, then unwind in the relaxation room. Head out on the reservoir in the rowing boats, free of charge. In the evening, gather round the big fire pit and grill. We're happy to help you organise a party, wedding or company event.
